findings.identity: Neet retains a full narrow tan torso, fine long legs, projecting muzzle, broad triangular ears and tiny nub. Buddy has a deep chest, continuous slightly elongated charcoal body, hanging ears and pale beard/brows; his wider braced stance does not erase clearance.
findings.anatomy_support_perspective: Four legs on each dog have plausible shoulder/pelvis roots; far legs overlap coherently. All visible paws land on the wooden plane with contact shadows. Low camera and Buddy farther back explain scale. Sagar hand attaches to cropped arm and keys.
findings.grooming_finish: Large smooth painted body fields replace engraved curls. Neet coat is close and smooth. Buddy furnished head and distal paws remain distinct from close torso. Pale chest edges have short irregular marking contours but no raised shag volume or repeated engraved body strokes.
findings.scene_comedy_setting: Alert Neet sights keys while Buddy braces after waking; empty floor contains no premature bones. Sun patches and living-room furniture match the setup. Comic contrast is readable through neck/ear alertness versus Buddy’s wider sleepy stance; no geographic or household contradiction.
